lines.text: Never pick up a hitchhiker your dashcam can't see.
2 AM on Route 6. A man in a yellow raincoat waved me down.
lines.say: Two A.M. on Route six. A man in a yellow raincoat waved me down.

lines.text: He got in. He didn't say a word.
At the gas station, I checked my dashcam.
The passenger seat was empty. The whole ride.
But the seat belt was buckled.
Then the audio played a voice: thanks for stopping.

lines.say: The file was dated October nineteen ninety-six.

lines.text: I looked at the seat next to me.
The belt was still buckled. And pulling tight.
So never pick up a hitchhiker your dashcam can't see.
